title: Pools
items: What is a parent pool?
A collection of MDisks that are split into extents
A collection of hosts that share volumes
A group of nodes that form an I/O group
A set of snapshots with the same retention
Parent Pool 是 MDisk 的集合；建立 Pool 時 MDisk 會被切成 Extent，Volume 由 Extent 組成並跨 MDisk 做 Striping。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch3 Parent Pools
Up to how many extents can a system manage?
2^22 extents
2^16 extents
2^32 extents
2^10 extents
系統最多可管理 2^22 個 Extent，因此 Extent Size 會決定系統可管理的總容量。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch3 Choosing an extent size
With a 2048 MB extent size, up to how much storage can the system manage?
8 PB
2 PB
32 PB
512 TB
2^22 個 Extent × 2048 MB ＝ 8 PB。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch3
Can the extent size of a pool be changed after the pool is created?
No, it cannot be changed
Yes, with the chmdiskgrp -extsize command
Yes, but only when the pool is empty
Yes, only for data reduction pools
Pool 建立後就不能更改 Extent Size，規劃時需一併考量最大 Volume 大小與可管理容量。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch3
Between which pools can volumes be migrated?
Only between pools with the same extent size
Between any pools regardless of extent size
Only between child pools
Only between pools on different systems
Volume 只能在 Extent Size 相同的 Pool 之間移轉。
Concept Guide Ch3 Important
How do fully allocated volumes allocate capacity?
In whole extents, rounding up to the next extent boundary
In 256 KiB grains
In 1 MB chunks regardless of extent size
Only when the host writes data
Fully Allocated Volume 以整個 Extent 配置容量，必要時取整至下一個 Extent 邊界，因此 Extent 越大可能浪費越多。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch3
How do larger extent sizes affect Easy Tier?
They reduce migration granularity and capacity optimization precision
They make Easy Tier migrations faster and more precise
They disable Easy Tier
They have no effect because Easy Tier works on blocks
Easy Tier 以 Extent 為單位移轉，Extent 越大，移轉粒度越粗、容量最佳化精準度越低。
Concept Guide Ch3 Choosing an extent size
Which MDisks can be added to a pool?
Only MDisks in unmanaged mode
Only MDisks in image mode
Only MDisks in managed mode
Any MDisk, including excluded MDisks
只能加入 Unmanaged 模式的 MDisk；加入 Parent Pool 後模式會變為 Managed。
Concept Guide Ch3 Parent Pools
What happens to existing data when an MDisk is added to a pool as an MDisk?
The existing data is deleted
The data is automatically imported as an image-mode volume
The data is moved to a child pool
The data is preserved and striped
將 MDisk 以一般 MDisk 加入 Pool 會刪除其上既有資料；要保留資料應建立 Image-mode Volume。
Concept Guide Ch3 Attention
What happens to a warning threshold on a pool?
A warning event is generated when used capacity exceeds the threshold
The pool goes offline at the threshold
New volume creation is blocked at the threshold
Easy Tier is disabled at the threshold
Pool 可設定 Warning Threshold，已用容量超過時產生警告 Event，對自動使用 Pool 容量的 Thin Volume 特別有用。
Concept Guide Ch3 Parent Pools
When can you remove an MDisk from a parent pool?
When enough free extents exist elsewhere in the pool to move the in-use extents
Only when the pool contains no volumes
Only after deleting all child pools
Only when the MDisk is offline
Pool 中其他 MDisk 有足夠的 Free Extent 時才能移除 MDisk，系統會將使用中的 Extent 移轉到其他 MDisk。
Concept Guide Ch3 Parent Pools
What must be done before deleting a parent pool that has child pools?
Delete the child pools first to return their extents to the parent pool
Convert the child pools into parent pools
Migrate the parent pool to another system
Nothing; child pools are deleted automatically
Parent Pool 若有 Child Pool，必須先刪除 Child Pool 並把 Extent 還給 Parent，才能刪除 Parent Pool。
Concept Guide Ch3 Parent Pools
What happens to a mirrored volume when its pool is deleted and all synchronized copies are in that pool?
The mirrored volume is destroyed
The volume moves automatically to another pool
The volume becomes image mode
The volume stays online read-only
Mirrored Volume 若所有同步 Copy 都在同一 Pool，刪除該 Pool 會一併刪除 Volume；若另一 Pool 有同步 Copy 則 Volume 保留。
Concept Guide Ch3 Parent Pools
When a child pool is created without a quota, what capacity can it access?
The entire usable capacity of the parent pool without limit
Only 50% of the parent pool
Only the capacity of one MDisk
No capacity until a quota is set
沒有 Quota 的 Child Pool 可無限制使用 Parent Pool 全部 Usable Capacity，兩者回報的 Usable Capacity 相同。
Concept Guide Ch3 Child Pools
Which type of child pool cannot be created with a quota?
Data reduction child pool
Standard child pool
Encrypted standard child pool
Child pool assigned to an ownership group
Standard Child Pool 可指定 size 建立 Quota；Data Reduction Child Pool 不能建立 Quota。
Concept Guide Ch3 Child Pools
Can you shrink the usable capacity of a child pool below its used capacity?
No
Yes, the excess data is moved to the parent pool
Yes, the oldest volumes are deleted
Yes, if Easy Tier is off
Child Pool 的 Usable Capacity 不能縮小到低於已用容量；縮小時系統也會重設 Warning Level。
Concept Guide Ch3 Child Pools
How does an encrypted data reduction child pool obtain its encryption key?
It inherits the encryption key from the encrypted parent pool
It always generates its own key
It uses the key of the first array
It does not support encryption
加密的 Data Reduction Child Pool 只能在 Parent Pool 已加密時建立，並繼承 Parent 的 Key。
Concept Guide Ch3 Child Pools
How must ownership of child pools be assigned?
Explicitly; child pools do not inherit ownership from parent resources
Automatically from the parent pool
From the first volume created in the pool
From the user who logs in
Child Pool 的 Ownership 必須明確指派，不會繼承；建在 Child Pool 的 Volume 則會繼承 Child Pool 的 Ownership Group。
Concept Guide Ch3 Child Pools
Is migrating a volume copy directly between child pools with different parent pools supported?
No; migrate through the parent pools instead
Yes, directly in one step
Yes, but only for thin volumes
Yes, only with FlashCopy
不同 Parent Pool 的 Child Pool 之間不支援直接移轉；需先移到來源 Parent，再到目標 Parent，最後到目標 Child Pool。
Concept Guide Ch3 Child Pools
What does the pool state Degraded ports indicate?
One or more 1220 errors were logged, meaning a remote Fibre Channel port was excluded from the MDisk
One or more nodes cannot access all MDisks
The pool is out of capacity
Easy Tier migration is paused
Degraded Ports 表示 MDisk 記錄了 1220 錯誤，即遠端 FC Port 被排除，通常是外部儲存硬體問題。
Concept Guide Ch3 Table 16 Pool states
What happens if a single MDisk in a pool is offline and cannot be seen by any online node?
The whole pool goes offline, taking its volume copies offline
Only the volumes on that MDisk go offline
The pool stays online in degraded paths state
The MDisk is automatically removed
Pool 中任何一個 MDisk 對所有 Online Node 都不可見時，整個 Pool 會 Offline，該 Pool 提供的所有 Volume Copy 都會 Offline。
Concept Guide Ch3 Attention
What is an array in Storage Virtualize?
A type of MDisk made up of drives that are its members
A group of hosts
A group of pools
A set of replication policies
Array 是由 Drive 組成的有序群組，屬於一種 MDisk，Drive 是 Array 的成員。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch3 Array configurations
A distributed RAID array with more than two drives has at least how many rebuild areas?
One
Zero
Two
Four
超過兩顆 Drive 的 Distributed RAID Array 至少有一個 Rebuild Area。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch3
Which process restores redundancy in a degraded distributed RAID array when no rebuild area is available?
Rebuild-in-place
Copyback to a hot spare
Easy Tier balancing
Volume mirroring resync
沒有可用的 Rebuild Area 時，以 Rebuild-in-place 將資料或 Parity 直接重建回替換的成員 Drive。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch3
How many drives can a distributed RAID 5 array support?
4 - 128 drives
2 - 16 drives
6 - 256 drives
3 - 48 drives
Distributed RAID 5 支援 4–128 顆 Drive，只能容忍一顆成員 Drive 失效。
Concept Guide Ch3 Supported RAID levels
How many concurrent member drive failures can distributed RAID 6 tolerate?
Two
One
Three
Zero
Distributed RAID 6 每個 Stripe 有兩個 Parity Strip，可容忍任意兩顆成員 Drive 同時失效。
Concept Guide Ch3 Supported RAID levels
What is true about distributed RAID 1?
It has two mirrored strips and no parity strips
It has one parity strip per stripe
It requires at least 4 drives
It cannot use rebuild-in-place
Distributed RAID 1 由兩份 Mirrored Strip 組成，沒有 Parity；兩顆成員的 DRAID 1 沒有 Rebuild Area。
Concept Guide Ch3 Supported RAID levels
What is the distributed RAID array strip size?
256 KiB
64 KiB
1 MiB
4 KiB
Distributed RAID 的 Strip Size 為 256 KiB。
Concept Guide Ch3 Stripe and stripe width
What does the rebuild area provide?
Reserved drive capacity used to reconstruct data after a drive failure; it provides no usable capacity
Extra usable capacity for volumes
Write cache for the array
A dedicated hot spare drive
Rebuild Area 是 Array 內保留、分散於所有 Drive 的容量，用於 Drive 失效後重建資料，不提供 Usable Capacity。
Concept Guide Ch3 Rebuild area
When expanding a distributed RAID array, what stays the same?
Stripe width and parity ratio
Number of drives
Usable capacity
Number of rebuild areas always
Distributed RAID 擴充為動態且不中斷，系統自動重新 Striping，但 Stripe Width 與 Parity 比例不變。
簡報 S6
Which rule applies when an array includes self-compressing drives?
Only one distributed RAID array of self-compressing drives is allowed per storage pool
Self-compressing and non-compressing drives can be mixed
Only RAID 1 is supported
Each pool must have at least two such arrays
自壓縮 Drive 不能與非壓縮 Drive 混在同一 Array，且每個 Pool 只允許一個自壓縮 Drive 的 DRAID Array。
Concept Guide Ch3 Distributed RAID arrays
For an array of self-compressing drives with at least 7 drives, which configuration is recommended?
Distributed RAID 6
Distributed RAID 5
Distributed RAID 1
Distributed RAID 10
至少 7 顆自壓縮 Drive 時建議 Distributed RAID 6，確保 Rebuild 期間有足夠容量。
Concept Guide Ch3 Distributed RAID arrays
How many rebuild areas do compressing NVMe distributed RAID arrays support?
One
Up to four
Two
None
SAS 與非壓縮 NVMe DRAID 最多建議 4 個 Rebuild Area；壓縮 NVMe DRAID 只支援 1 個。
Concept Guide Ch3 Distributed RAID array configuration guidelines
Which command displays the system recommendations for configuring an array?
lsarrayrecommendation
lsdriveclass
mkdistributedarray
lsarraymember
`lsarrayrecommendation` 顯示 Array 建議 Configuration；`mkdistributedarray` 用來建立 DRAID。
Concept Guide Ch3
When replacing a failed member drive, which drive class can the system use?
The same drive class or a superior drive class
Any drive class
Only a lower capacity drive class
Only drives from external storage
系統可使用相同或更優 (Superior，例如容量較大) 的 Drive Class 替換失效成員。
Concept Guide Ch3 Drive class
What is the default value of slow_write_priority when a distributed RAID array is created?
latency
redundancy
performance
off
slow_write_priority 預設為 latency，允許短暫降低冗餘以避免慢速 Drive 拖累 I/O；可按 Array 停用。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch3 Slow write priority settings
Which MDisk access mode indicates the MDisk is not being used by the system?
Unmanaged
Managed
Image
Array
Unmanaged 表示 MDisk 未被系統使用；Managed 已指派給 Pool；Image 直接對應既有資料；Array 由內部 Drive 組成。
簡報 S7
Which MDisk mode is used to import existing data and for migration?
Image
Managed
Unmanaged
Excluded
Image Mode 讓 MDisk 直接對應 Volume，保留既有資料，用於匯入與移轉。
簡報 S7、S11
What can make an MDisk become Excluded?
Unstable connectivity, which requires the MDisk to be included manually
Adding it to a child pool
Enabling Easy Tier
Creating snapshots on it
連線不穩可能使 MDisk 變成 Excluded，需手動 Include。MDisk 本身不會被 Host 看見。
簡報 S7
Which commands query the location of bad blocks on MDisks?
dumpmdiskbadblocks and dumpallmdiskbadblocks
lsmdisklba and lsvdisklba
svc_snap and livedump
lsmdisk -badblocks
系統維護 Bad Block 表記錄無法讀取的 LBA，可用 `dumpmdiskbadblocks`、`dumpallmdiskbadblocks` 查詢。
簡報 S8
How do you enable protection information on drives that existed before an upgrade?
Unmanage the drives and rediscover them so the software reacquires drive characteristics
Run chsystem -protection on
It is enabled automatically after the upgrade
Replace all drives
升級前既有的 Drive 不會自動啟用，需 Unmanage 後重新探索；`lsdrive` 的 protection_enabled 顯示是否使用。
簡報 S9
When planning external storage, what is recommended for each array?
Create a single LU from the whole array instead of splitting it into multiple logical disks
Split each array into many small LUs
Use RAID 0 for best performance
Mix drive types in one array
外部 Array 盡量以整個 Array 建立單一 LU，不要切成多個 Logical Disk；RAID 5 建議 5+P 至 8+P。
簡報 S10
A zone that contains storage ports must not exceed how many ports?
含儲存 Port 的 Zone 不得超過 40 個 Port，Host 與儲存 Port 建議分開 Zone。
簡報 S10
What happens if not all nodes are connected to the same set of external storage ports?
The MDisks become degraded
Performance improves
The external storage becomes image mode
Nothing; this is recommended
所有 Node 必須連到同一組外部儲存 Port，否則會呈現 Degraded。
簡報 S10
Which command manually triggers discovery of external storage?
detectmdisk
lscontroller
includemdisk
addmdisk
Discovery 在 Port 變動或錯誤時自動執行，也可用 GUI 的 Discover Storage 或 `detectmdisk` 手動觸發。
簡報 S11
Which feature is enabled by default in data reduction pools to reclaim capacity that is no longer used?
SCSI Unmap
Easy Tier acceleration
Volume protection
Slow write priority
Data Reduction Pool 預設啟用 SCSI Unmap，回收 Host 不再使用的容量。
簡報 S13
Which systems do NOT support data reduction pools?
Systems that support FCM5 drives
Systems with external storage
Systems with Easy Tier
Systems with child pools
依簡報整理，支援 FCM5 Drive 的系統不支援 Data Reduction Pool。
簡報 S13
When both a parent pool and its child pool have throttles, which limit applies to the child pool?
The more restrictive one, and I/O counts against both pools
Only the parent pool throttle
Only the child pool throttle
The sum of both limits
兩層都有 Throttle 時，Child Pool 採較嚴格者，且 I/O 會同時計入兩個 Pool；Mirrored Volume 只看主要 Copy 的 Throttle。
簡報 S14
What is the default Easy Tier migration rate, and what does easytieracceleration on raise it to?
12 GB per 5 minutes, raised to 48 GB per 5 minutes
48 GB per 5 minutes, raised to 96 GB
1 GB per minute, raised to 4 GB
6 GB per 5 minutes, raised to 12 GB
預設移轉速率為 12 GB / 5 分鐘，`chsystem -easytieracceleration on` 可提高到 48 GB / 5 分鐘，適合新增容量後暫時啟用。
簡報 S16
Where are Easy Tier reports found in the management GUI, and what period does the Data Movement report cover?
Monitoring > Easy Tier Reports; the previous 24 hours in hourly intervals
Pools > Properties; the previous 7 days
Settings > Support; the previous 30 days
Volumes > Volumes by Pool; the last 5 minutes
Easy Tier 報告位於 Monitoring > Easy Tier Reports；Data Movement 顯示前 24 小時、每小時一格，另有 Tier Composition 與 Workload Skew Comparison，可下載 CSV。
簡報 S17
